No. G50] PORT MORESBY, FRIDAY, 10th FEBRUARY [2012

National Information and Communications Technology Act 2009
NOTICE OF MAKING OF MANDATORY INSTRUMENTS UNDER THE NATIONAL ICT ACT 2009

I, Charles S. Punaha, Chief Executive Officer of the National Information and Communications Technology Authority
(also referred to as NICTA), by virtue of the powers conferred by Sections 47(2)(c), 55 and 218 of the National ICT
Act 2009 and s.6(1) of the National Information and Communications Technology (Operator Licensing) Regulations
2010 and all other powers me enabling, hereby give notice fo the following instruments that have been made by NICTA
pursuant to the National ICT Act 2009.

1. Terms and Conditions for Special Temporary Licences Rule 2011 pursuant to Sections 47(2)(c), 55 and 218
of the National ICT Act 2009; and

2. Standard and Special Conditions of Individual Licences Rule 2011 pursuant to Sections 55 and 218 of the
National ICT Act 2009 and _s.6(1) of the National Information and Communications Technology (Operator Licensing)
Regulations 2010.

3. Spectrum Trading Rules pursuant to Section s.218 of the National ICT Act 2009 and s.17 of the National
Information and Communications Technology (Operator Licensing) Regulations 2010.

The Spectrum Trading Rules shall take effect on 1st January, 2012.

4. Determination of Service Specific Principles pursuant to subsection 135(4) of the National ICT Act 2009 for
NICTA has made Determinations of Service-Specific Pricing Principles for:

(a) Domestic Mobile Terminating Access Services; and
(b) Domestic Fixed Terminating Access Services.
This Determinations take effect from 29th October, 2010.

Dated this 9th day of February, 2012.

C. S. PUNAHA,
Chief Executive Officer.

Printed and Published by K. Kaiah, Government Printer,
Port Moresby.—50.
